articles.headline: New York couple names son Knickson Fyve after Knicks title chant
articles.description: Vance and Yvonne Bradford's newborn son is named for the popular chant that filled the streets of New York after the Knicks' first title in over 50 years.
articles.headlineJa: ニューヨークの夫婦、ニックスの優勝チャントにちなんで息子を「ニクソン・ファイブ」と命名
articles.descriptionJa: ヴァンス・ブラッドフォードさんとイヴォンヌ・ブラッドフォードさんの新生児の息子は、ニックスが50年以上ぶりにタイトルを獲得した後、ニューヨークの街に響き渡った人気のチャントにちなんで名付けられました。
articles.body:
Late at night on June 13, as the final buzzer sounded on the win that clinched the New York Knicks' first championship in over a half century, a popular question -- equal parts joking and legitimate -- began making the rounds: How many babies in the New York area were about to be named Jalen?

The reference, of course, being to star Knicks point guard Jalen Brunson, who dropped 45 points in the Finals-clinching win. That uptick might have already occurred. According to one report, 32 babies were named Jalen in New York City between March and early October this year -- more than double the 15 from the same period last year.

Vance and Yvonne Bradford, die-hard Knicks fans who were expecting a child of their own that summer, had heard the jokes.

"A lot of the jokes going around, memes on social media, was 'There's going to be a lot of Jalens named after this. There's going to be a lot of KATs. OGs.' And everyone was joking about how many 'Knicks names' would come of this," Vance Bradford recalled to ESPN.

But Yvonne Bradford had another idea.

After New York won Game 5, the Bradfords heard a common refrain among the full-throated jubilance of New York City.

"We opened our windows after the Knicks won and we heard the chants: 'Knicks in five! Knicks in five!' And that kind of sat with us," Vance said.

"We had a boy name and we had a girl name. My wife asks me maybe the next morning ... 'What about the name Knickson?'"

Initially, the plan was to just stick with Knickson (pronounced "Nixon") as a first name, and then go a more conventional route with the child's middle name. But then Yvonne posed the question: If they had already committed to the first name, why not go all the way?

"Two days later my wife was like, 'Let's go full force with this. Let's call him Knickson Fyve.'"

Vance took a "split-second" to ensure she wasn't joking with him and quickly agreed "so she can't take it back."

She didn't. The name was locked in.

The name is a tribute to the Bradfords' favorite team, yes, but also to the impact its success this summer had on their longtime home. Both Vance and Yvonne are native Brooklynites (Bed-Stuy and Crown Heights, respectively), and Vance said he saw something special in the city when his childhood team finally hoisted the Larry O'Brien Trophy for the first time in his lifetime.

"The impact that it made to the city, what I think a lot of people miss, is that the win was so impactful to the city," he said. "It looks good, and everyone says, 'Oh we were cheering,' but I mean [it] seriously changed the behavior of the city in the most positive way."

As for their son's name being one of many inspired by the hometown team's championship, Vance Bradford isn't shying away from the possibility of Knickson being in a classroom in a few years with multiple Knicks-related names, be it a Jalen or a Karl-Anthony. For all he knows, Knickson might not even be the only child born over the past few months to be named after the chant.

articles.headline: Dallas Cowboys cheerleaders unionize, will begin collective bargaining
articles.description: The Dallas Cowboys have agreed to recognize the Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders Association as the collective bargaining representative for the team's cheer squad.
articles.headlineJa: ダラス・カウボーイズのチアリーダーが労働組合を結成、団体交渉を開始へ
articles.descriptionJa: ダラス・カウボーイズは、チームのチアリーダー団の団体交渉代表として「ダラス・カウボーイズ・チアリーダーズ協会」を認めることに合意しました。
articles.body:
DALLAS -- The Dallas Cowboys cheerleaders are unionizing.

The NFL franchise has agreed to recognize the Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders Association as the collective bargaining representative for one of the most famous cheer squads in professional sports, both sides said in a joint statement Friday, which follows years of the cheerleaders fighting for pay increases.

"The Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders are an esteemed part of the Cowboys organization, deeply respected for the talent and dedication they exhibit," the statement said. "They remain one of the most sought-after opportunities for talented dancers worldwide."

During the second season of the Netflix series "America's Sweethearts: Dallas Cowboy Cheerleaders," which aired last year, one of the cheerleaders said the members were getting a 400% boost in pay. In 2019, the Cowboys settled a lawsuit with a former cheerleader that led to the squad doubling the per-game pay, from $200 to $400. So the raise announced in 2025 was four times that.

A contact for the Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders Association could not immediately be found on Friday.

The Cowboys have been the most valuable pro sports team in the world, according to Forbes magazine.

articles.headline: Roberto De Zerbi defends Spurs' 'high level' medical staff amid injury crisis
articles.description: Roberto De Zerbi has defended Tottenham's medical staff despite an ongoing injury crisis.
articles.headlineJa: ロベルト・デ・ゼルビ監督、負傷者続出の中でもスパーズの「ハイレベルな」医療スタッフを擁護
articles.descriptionJa: ロベルト・デ・ゼルビ監督は、負傷者が相次ぐ危機的な状況にありながらも、トッテナムの医療スタッフを擁護しました。
articles.body:
Roberto De Zerbi has defended Tottenham's medical staff despite an ongoing injury crisis.

Spurs travel to rivals Chelsea on Saturday night, but will be without several key figures and Dejan Kulusevski and James Maddison are doubts following disrupted training this week after they featured in Monday's win over Coventry.

Destiny Udogie remains sidelined and Tosin Adarabioyo may not recover in time. Pedro Porro is available in a welcome boost, but fitness problems have been a frequent issue for Tottenham this season and during recent campaigns.

Yet De Zerbi said: "It's football. I am convinced our medical staff this season is high level.

"I follow them. I believe in them. I have big confidence because I know how they are working.

"I think they are good enough to believe in them. Nothing more. We are suffering a normal situation in football."

De Zerbi went on to highlight three players and the unique circumstances surrounding their fitness issues.

Porro "suffered in the World Cup the muscular problem of the hamstring," which was behind his absence at the start of the season.

The Spanish right-back returned against Aston Villa, but "pushed to come back before the right time and he suffered another injury."

De Zerbi pointed out: "What is the responsibility of the medical team?"

On the sidelined Lucas Bergvall, De Zerbi added: "In the beginning of the [Manchester United] game, in the tackle, he turned his knee and felt pain.

"He finished the game and the day after he felt pain. What is the responsibility of the medical staff? Nothing.

"[Andy] Robertson played four games in a row with the national team.

"[Against Coventry] was fatigued. It's normal fatigue for a player who played six games in 20 days.

"At the end of this season we make the total report and we analyse the situation but so far we can't say anything bad about the medical staff or another reason."

- Tottenham's Roberto De Zerbi denies Chelsea raids of former club Brighton are extra motivation for derby

- Tottenham beat Arsenal in ex-footballer boxing fight, Nile Ranger pulls out

- James Maddison apologises to Coventry fans for Tottenham goal celebration

What cannot be debated is Tottenham's horrendous away record at Chelsea which includes only one win in 41 matches at Stamford Bridge but De Zerbi, who won there with Brighton in 2023, has a positive experience to lean on.

"When I was the coach of Foggia. League Three against League Two, many, many times Foggia did not win in the [Bari] stadium but it was one motivation more, not one pressure more," De Zerbi said. "And yes, we won [in 2015]."

articles.headline: USMNT's Scally scores, helps Gladbach avoid worst-ever Bundesliga start
articles.description: Borussia Mönchengladbach avoided becoming the first team in Bundesliga history to lose seven straight games to start the season, thanks to a 3-2 win at Stuttgart on Friday.
articles.headlineJa: 米代表スカリーが得点、グラッドバッハがブンデスリーガ史上最悪の開幕戦連敗を回避
articles.descriptionJa: ボルシア・メンヒェングラートバッハは、金曜日のシュトゥットガルト戦に3-2で勝利し、ブンデスリーガ史上初の開幕7連敗という不名誉を免れました。
articles.body:
Borussia Mönchengladbach avoided becoming the first team in Bundesliga history to lose seven straight games to start the season, thanks to a 3-2 win at Stuttgart on Friday.

United States defender Joe Scally led the way for Gladbach with a goal and an assist as they got their long-awaited first points of the campaign.

- Bayern Munich coach Kompany hospitalized after collapsing at training

- Dortmund's new app rewards fans who lock phones while at stadium

- Musah is back in Milan, back in midfield and back in contention for the USMNT

Gladbach came into the game with a club record goals against tally of minus-20 after six games, and they looked set for a seventh straight loss when they went behind after six minutes through Ermedin Demirović.

However, in one of the turnarounds of the Bundesliga so far, Scally's fourth goal of the season via a deft backheel brought Gladbach level seven minutes before halftime. Shuto Machino then gave the visitors the unlikeliest of leads six minutes into the second period.

Having set up Gladbach's second goal, Wael Mohya made sure of the points with a header from a Scally cross midway through the second half. It was the 17-year-old's second goal in two games.

Demirović pulled a goal back for the home side with seven minutes left but it was not enough.

"It's an amazing feeling to finally get our first win of the season," Mohya said. "We came here determined to get something from the game, so I'm absolutely delighted that we managed to do that.

"Being able to help the team with an assist and a goal makes it even better. The coach always tells us to fight and give everything for the team. Today we saw that all that hard work pays off. We need to build on this performance and take the momentum into the next few games."

Despite the win, Gladbach remain at the foot of the Bundesliga table. Stuttgart are 14th, ahead of the rest of the weekend's action.

The Associated Press contributed to this report.

articles.headline: Seahawks rule out RB Zach Charbonnet vs. Chiefs
articles.description: RB Zach Charbonnet's season debut will have to wait at least one more week as the Seahawks have ruled him out for Sunday's game against the Chiefs.
articles.headlineJa: シーホークス、チーフス戦でのRBザック・シャルボネットの出場を回避
articles.descriptionJa: シーホークスが日曜日のチーフス戦での出場を見送ったため、RBザック・シャルボネットの今シーズン初出場は少なくとももう1週間待つことになります。
articles.body:
RENTON, Wash. -- Zach Charbonnet's season debut will have to wait at least one more week as the Seattle Seahawks have ruled out the running back for Sunday night's game against the Kansas City Chiefs.

Charbonnet is roughly eight months removed from surgery to repair a torn left ACL. He resumed practicing Oct. 1, progressed to full participation Wednesday and was activated off the physically unable to perform list on Thursday.

Coach Mike Macdonald on Friday said Charbonnet did not suffer a setback, and that "if anything, it's going as good as we could hope it could go."

The team listed Charbonnet as a full participant all three days this week. He'd previously been listed as limited on all eight of the injury reports released once he returned to practice.

"I think we're going along with the plan," Macdonald said. "The plan was to get a great week's worth of work and see where we're at, and so we're going to take it into next week. I'd just say it's part of the plan. Zach's doing great, and we'll go into next week, see how it goes."

The defending Super Bowl champions will get right guard Anthony Bradford (knee) back for Sunday's game, but they're dealing with injuries to several other starters as they try to snap a two-game losing streak.

Weakside linebacker Drake Thomas (ankle) will miss a second straight game, while outside linebackers DeMarcus Lawrence (knee) and Uchenna Nwosu (hip) as well as safety Nick Emmanwori (hip) are questionable.

"I wouldn't say he got hurt," Macdonald said of Emmanwori. "He just had a hip today."

Quarterback Drew Lock (right elbow) and outside linebacker Connor O'Toole (hamstring) are also questionable, while linebacker Chazz Surratt (calf) is out. All five of Seattle's questionable players were listed as limited participants Friday.

Macdonald said he is planning for Bradford, who has missed the past five games, to play the whole game after rotating Christian Haynes and Beau Stephens in his absence. Seattle will have to activate Bradford off injured reserve by Saturday.

With Charbonnet not yet ready and rookie first-round pick Jadarian Price still on IR, the Seahawks' top three running backs are Emanuel Wilson, George Holani and Velus Jones Jr. Price, who has missed the past three games with a chest injury, will be eligible to return off IR next week.

"J.D.'s doing well," Macdonald said Friday. "We'll look at it. Next week I believe is when his window can open."

The Seahawks on Friday signed wide receiver/special teamer Irv Charles off their practice squad, released Trevon Diggs and then re-signed the cornerback to their practice squad. As a vested veteran, Diggs did not have to go through waivers.

articles.headline: Giants LB Tremaine Edmunds (chest) out for year, source says
articles.description: Giants linebacker Tremaine Edmunds will miss the rest of the season with a torn chest muscle, a source told ESPN's Jordan Raanan. Edmunds leads the team with 50 tackles and wears the green dot to make the calls on defense.
articles.headlineJa: ジャイアンツのLBトレメイン・エドモンズ、胸の負傷で今季絶望
articles.descriptionJa: ジャイアンツのラインバッカー、トレメイン・エドモンズが胸の筋肉断裂により今シーズンの残り試合を欠場することが、ESPNのジョーダン・ラーナン記者への情報提供で明らかになった。エドモンズはチーム最多の50タックルを記録しており、守備陣の指令塔（グリーン・ドット）を務めている。
articles.body:
EAST RUTHERFORD, N.J. -- New York Giants middle linebacker Tremaine Edmunds is out for the season with a torn chest muscle, a source told ESPN.

Edmunds signed a three-year, $36 million deal with the Giants this offseason. He led the team with 50 tackles and was tied for the team lead with two sacks through six games this season.

New York will also be without outside linebacker Chauncey Golston for the remainder of the season, sources told ESPN. Golston was placed on injured reserve earlier this month with a neck injury.

Edmunds, 28, was hurt on one of the final plays of Sunday's 34-27 loss to the New Orleans Saints. The team was trying to determine this week if it was something Edmunds could manage. He wanted to play through the injury, but it was determined that would not be possible.

The veteran linebacker was one of the leaders of the Giants' defense. He was on the team's leadership counsel and wore the green dot to make the calls on defense.

Veteran Micah McFadden will take his place and is expected to wear the green dot and communicate directly with defensive coordinator Dennard Wilson. The Giants have maintained since the summer that they have three starting middle linebackers on the roster with Edmunds, Arvell Reese and McFadden.

"I think I said early on we have three starters. So, when and if that happens, Micah is ready [to start]," coach John Harbaugh said earlier Friday. "He's a starter, and he'll play really well. He'll be excited for his opportunity."

McFadden has started 36 games in his career. He will be in the middle of the defense Sunday against the Houston Texans (2-4).

The Giants (3-2-1) also expect to have cornerback Paulson Adebo return from a knee injury. He was on injured reserve but had his window to return opened earlier this week.

Starting offensive tackles Andrew Thomas (groin) and Jermaine Eluemunor (calf) should be available despite being listed as questionable for the contest. Harbaugh said Friday they "should have a good chance" to play.

articles.headline: Cowboys say still time to turn things around after 2-4 start
articles.description: Cowboys stars Dak Prescott and CeeDee Lamb express belief that there's still time for the team to turn things around despite a 2-4 start.
articles.headlineJa: カウボーイズ、2勝4敗の出だしながら巻き返しの余地ありと語る
articles.descriptionJa: カウボーイズのスター選手であるダック・プレスコットとシーディー・ラムは、2勝4敗というスタートを切ったものの、チームが巻き返す時間はまだ十分にあると自信を見せた。
articles.body:
FRISCO, Texas -- At 2-4 and in the midst of a two-game losing streak, Dak Prescott knows it is time for the Dallas Cowboys to turn the season around.

He said the mindset of the team is "determined, and I would hope urgent," heading into Monday's game against the Philadelphia Eagles at Lincoln Financial Field.

"We can only say we've got a lot of games in front of us for so long. Might be already past us, right? We've got to go win," Prescott said. "You've got to go win. You want to give yourself a chance to be a winning team, to be a playoff team. You got to win as many games as you can, and when you drop two games -- in particular games that we didn't expect to drop -- it makes it that much harder. So urgent, urgent to get it done now."

Despite the record, ESPN Analytics still gives the Cowboys the best chance to win the NFC East at 68%. The New York Giants are currently in first place with a 3-2-1 record but will turn to J.J. McCarthy as their starting quarterback. Like the Cowboys, the Eagles are 2-4, but they will be without quarterback Jalen Hurts for the rest of the regular season due to blood clots. The Washington Commanders are in last place with a 1-4-1 record.

Wide receiver CeeDee Lamb said, "Anybody can win this division, so why not us?

He added, "Very fortunate that everybody else is playing pretty bad. But overall, just everything is still in front of us. We still have our opportunity to do what we want to do, and that's to get in the tournament, and it starts on Monday. So just shaking that back and getting back into the win column I feel like is the most important thing, and that's been the point of emphasis this week."

The Cowboys' defense has struggled this season under first-year coordinator Christian Parker -- 25th in points per game (26.5), 30th in yards (382.5), including the last-ranked run defense (149.8 yards) -- and the Dallas offense has hit a wall the last two weeks, scoring just 29 points.

The Cowboys have not been able to sustain a running game, and there has been a lack of big plays, in part because of how they have handled the blitz in the last two games. Dallas coach Brian Schottenheimer, who serves as the playcaller, has come under criticism with an offense that was among the most accomplished last year and returned everybody in 2026.

"I think it comes with the territory. I think some of it is deserved. We've got to play better. I've got to coach better," Schottenheimer said Thursday. "When you grow up in a family that your dad's a head coach for over 20-something years, you understand that this is part of the job description. No one likes it. I block out most of it. Some of it gets to me doing this job, and having to speak to you guys is part of that. But at the same time, I've got strong shoulders.

"I know what a great coach I am. I know what this team is capable of, and that's what I focus on."

Perhaps playing in a hostile environment on ESPN's "Monday Night Football" can help.

articles.headline: 49ers WR Evans, DE Bosa, WR Samuel out vs. Atlanta; WR Kirk may return
articles.description: 49ers receivers Mike Evans and Deebo Samuel Sr., and defensive end Nick Bosa are among a half dozen players who have been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Falcons.
articles.headlineJa: 49ers、アトランタ戦にWRエバンス、DEボサ、WRサミュエルらが出場せず。WRカークは復帰の可能性
articles.descriptionJa: 49ersのレシーバー、マイク・エバンスとディーボ・サミュエルSr.、およびディフェンシブエンドのニック・ボサを含む計6名が、日曜日のファルコンズ戦を欠場することが決定した。
articles.body:
SANTA CLARA, Calif. -- With a bye week coming soon, San Francisco 49ers receiver Mike Evans and defensive end Nick Bosa won't play in Sunday's game against the Atlanta Falcons as they deal with Achilles tendinitis and a calf injury, respectively.

On Friday, the Niners ruled Evans and Bosa out against the Falcons after neither player participated in practice this week. In addition to Bosa and Evans, the Niners also ruled out wideout Deebo Samuel Sr. (hamstring), linebackers Luke Gifford (groin) and Garret Wallow (hamstring), and safety Marques Sigle (ankle).

Coach Kyle Shanahan said that with so many missing players, the Niners are likely to enter Sunday's game with fewer than the maximum 48 players on the game-day roster even after they make practice squad elevations on Saturday. They've had internal discussions with some of their players about further injuries forcing them to play out of position, according to Shanahan.

"I don't think ever in my career [has that happened]," Shanahan said. "It's a unique situation."

Evans' absence creates an even greater need this week given the team's rash of injuries at receiver. The 49ers are already without Ricky Pearsall (knee), Samuel, De'Zhaun Stribling (ankle) and Demarcus Robinson (ankle). One solution is the expected activation of veteran wideout Christian Kirk from injured reserve.

The 49ers released defensive end Ogbo Okoronkwo on Friday, creating a roster spot for Kirk. While he's technically listed as questionable, Shanahan said that is procedural and Kirk is set to play against the Falcons. Kirk has been on injured reserve since the start of the season after injuring a calf in the opening days of training camp in July.

Kirk said Thursday that he has felt good since returning to practice last week and was looking forward to getting back in the mix, especially considering the attrition at receiver.

"Thankfully for me, I've played enough ball, I've played a lot of football and have got a lot of experience," Kirk said. "This week has just been treating every rep like a game rep ... I know once I get out there on Sunday, if that's what the case is going to be, it's just like playing football again. I'm excited for that opportunity when it does present itself."

With Evans sitting out this week, he will have an extra week to deal with the Achilles tendinitis that flared up before Monday's game against the Washington Commanders. San Francisco has a Week 8 bye.

Evans didn't practice the week before the Washington game but played and was on his way to a big performance before the Achilles flared up just before halftime.

Evans did not return to the game. He was in the locker room moving slowly on specialized shoes but did not participate in practice this week.

Bosa, meanwhile, had recently expressed optimism that he could return from his calf injury for the Washington or Atlanta games, but the Niners held him out of practice also, giving him additional time to recover.

articles.headline: Fantasy football buzz: Caleb Williams shows he is all the way back in TNF win
articles.description: Caleb Williams did something no other Bears quarterback had done since 1962 as he led Chicago to a TNF win.
articles.headlineJa: ファンタジーフットボール最新情報：カレブ・ウィリアムズ、TNFの勝利で完全復活を証明
articles.descriptionJa: カレブ・ウィリアムズはシカゴをTNF（サーズナイトフットボール）での勝利に導き、1962年以来のベアーズQBとしての快挙を成し遂げた。
articles.body:
Everything that happens in the NFL has additional context when viewed from a fantasy football perspective. From position battles to injuries and so much more, the news cycle will constantly affect player values.

Our fantasy football buzz file, with contributions from our ESPN fantasy writers and our NFL Nation reporters, aims to provide fantasy managers with the intel they need as news breaks around the league.

Oct. 23:  Caleb Williams shows he is all the way back on TNF

By Adam Rank

There is going to be a lively debate between Chicago Bears and New England Patriots fans over the next number of years as to who got the better QB in the 2024 NFL draft. And, I hate to go all youth sports dad on you, but I'm just happy that both players are doing well.

And you should, too. Caleb Williams not only entered the NFL MVP conversation Thursday night, but he's a rock-solid starter for your fantasy team moving forward as well. This Bears offense has been on fire with Williams under center. The Bears have scored 120 points in the three games he has started and finished. He is just the third quarterback in Bears history with 300-plus passing yards and a win in back-to-back games, joining Billy Wade (1962) and Sid Luckman (1947). You can forgive Bears supporters for being a little excited about Caleb.

• You might remember when people were taunting Williams for being a checkdown merchant. Well, he had eight completions of 20-plus yards against the Patriots. That is tied for the most by a quarterback in a game this season.

• Luther Burden III has 250 yards after the catch this season, the second-highest total in the league behind Drake London (255). Burden finished the game with four receptions for 130 yards and a touchdown. He wasn't the target leader, but Burden is the top wide receiver to trust for the Bears moving forward.

• Rome Odunze was clutch down the stretch for the Bears. Two big grabs on the final drive to set up the field goal that made it a two-score game. He also corralled the onside kick to seal the win. Great for the Bears. I'm not sure he's going to be somebody you can rely on week to week in fantasy. He's good for bye-week and injury replacement, but don't rush him into your lineups.

• Colston Loveland is a must-start every week. He had that brutal first game. He did nothing in the monsoon game, either. But Loveland has looked like the tight end you drafted in the two games since Caleb returned to the lineup. Is he going to score a touchdown every week? I hope, as a Bears supporter and dude who drafted a ton of Loveland. While not likely to score every week (I'm not ruling it out), he needs to be started.

• A.J. Brown had three receptions on six targets for 48 yards. Not great. But let him take this time on the mini-bye to get back into playing shape. He might even be a great candidate to trade for if you can convince some manager it's time to move on.

articles.headline: Ipswich earn draw with Forest as Delap misfires on return
articles.description: Liam Delap fired a blank on his return to Ipswich with Nottingham Forest forced to settle for a 1-1 draw despite a dominant display at Portman Road.
articles.body:
Liam Delap fired a blank on his return to Ipswich with Nottingham Forest forced to settle for a 1-1 draw despite a dominant display at Portman Road.

Delap's 12-goal haul for Ipswich during the 2024-25 campaign earned a big-money move to Chelsea, but he returned to his old club with Forest on Friday with only two Premier League strikes to his name since he departed the Suffolk club.

Any hope of rediscovering that past form failed to materialise and Delap sent over a gilt-edged chance with 16 minutes left to ensure Forest remain with a haul of only one league victory from eight fixtures under Oliver Glasner.

Glasner will wonder how after Neco Williams' deservedly put the visitors in front in the 13th minute before Nikola Milenkovic gifted Gary O'Neil's side an equaliser with a poor back pass, which allowed Julio Enciso to level after 41 minutes.

Forest looked the more likely to grab a second-half winner and were frustrated that Issa Diop avoided a red card for a 47th-minute lunge on James McAtee, but Glasner in the end had to settle for a point.

Glasner stuck with Delap despite his costly misses at Crystal Palace and almost watched the away side score in the sixth minute.

Jair Cunha went close before Delap lashed well wide after good play by fit-again Morgan Gibbs-White.

While Forest started the day second from bottom, the visitors regularly belied their lowly position and broke the deadlock in classic Glasner fashion.

Delap initially held up well versus Diop, then Gibbs-White beat Dara O'Shea to the ball and played in Daniel Muñoz, who picked out fellow wing back Williams to send a right-footed volley past Christian Walton.

It was trademark Glasner and while Enciso curled a free kick over for Ipswich soon after, Forest remained dominant with Gibbs-White off target before only Leif Davis' excellent clearance on the line denied the England midfielder.

However, with four minutes of the first half left, Forest and specifically Milenkovic gifted Ipswich a leveller.

O'Shea's long ball was brought down by Milenkovic but his pass back to Matz Sels was weak and Enciso raced clear before he found the bottom corner.

VAR took centre stage at the start of the second half when referee Thomas Bramall inexplicably failed to penalise Diop for hauling down McAtee before he decided upon review to hand out only a yellow card.

Glasner's men failed to make the most of the subsequent free kick and yet went close on the hour mark with a Williams' shot blocked before Murillo's effort on the turn was saved.

Murillo and then Dan Ndoye went close in quick succession -- Davis again forced to produce a key intervention in front of goal.

articles.headline: Bayern Munich coach Vincent Kompany hospitalized after collapsing at training
articles.description: Bayern Munich coach Vincent Kompany is undergoing tests in hospital after collapsing during a training session Friday, the German club confirmed.
articles.headlineJa: バイエルン・ミュンヘンのコンパニー監督、練習中に倒れ入院
articles.descriptionJa: ドイツのバイエルン・ミュンヘンは、ヴィンセント・コンパニー監督が金曜日の練習中に倒れ、現在病院で検査を受けていることを認めた。
articles.body:
Bayern Munich coach Vincent Kompany is undergoing tests in hospital after collapsing during a training session on Friday, the German club confirmed.

Kompany had been suffering with a viral infection that was affecting his legs over the past week, though he was on the sideline for Bayern's Champions League match with Arsenal on Wednesday.

Bayern said that Kompany, 40, collapsed while watching a training session for the club's reserve team on Friday and required medical care.

"Kompany is undergoing thorough examinations in hospital and will remain under medical care," the club said. "His coaching staff will oversee training and match activities until further notice."

The club's director of sport, Max Eberl, said Kompany would be given "all the time he needs."

"Vincent Kompany's health is our top priority," Eberl said in a statement. "We at FC Bayern will do everything we can to ensure he makes a speedy recovery.

"Vinnie is receiving all the necessary medical care and support, and all the time he needs. His coaching team, in whom we have complete confidence, will take over his duties. All of us at FC Bayern wish Vinnie a speedy recovery."

Kompany was subdued and remained seated in Bayern's 6-1 win over Leipzig in the Bundesliga on Saturday.

Eberl said at the time that Kompany, who reportedly needed help to climb stairs, had been struggling with both the virus and a hip injury.

Ahead of the Arsenal game, assistant Aaron Danks assumed Kompany's training and media duties Tuesday.

"It has affected his legs at times and he's felt some pain," Danks said of Kompany on Tuesday.

"It's just a virus. The doctors, the experts, know way more than I do. The most important thing we've just encouraged is that he rests, he takes the time he needs, whatever that may be, however long that may be."

Following Wednesday's match, Kompany acknowledged he tried to push through the illness and failed to heed the signals from his body.

Bayern Munich, who are top of the German Bundesliga and level on points with Borussia Dortmund, next visit Freiburg on Sunday.

Kompany joined Bayern in 2024 from Burnley and has won the German league twice since then. Kompany's team also reached the Champions League semifinals and won the German Cup last season.

Among a raft of teams wishing Kompany well was Manchester City, where he was the long-time captain and won the Premier League four times.

"Everyone at Manchester City is wishing a speedy recovery to our former captain and Club legend, Vincent Kompany," City posted on X. "Get well soon, Vinny."

Information from The Associated Press contributed to this report

articles.headline: Phishing email to Knicks employees an 'unfortunate mistake,' MSG spokesman says
articles.description: A Madison Square Garden spokesman admitted fault that employees in Knicks business operations and at the arena received a phishing email posing as an opportunity to claim an NBA championship ring, calling the incident "an unfortunate mistake."
articles.body:
A Madison Square Garden spokesperson admitted fault that employees in Knicks business operations and at the arena received a phishing email posing as an opportunity to claim an NBA championship ring, calling the incident "an unfortunate mistake."

The Athletic reported Thursday that some employees received an email last month saying "your Employee Championship Ring is here" that said they could choose from a pair of options at "no cost to you."

When the employees clicked on a link in the email, The Athletic reported, they were informed that they had failed a phishing test and would have to attend a mandatory cybersecurity class.

"The company had previously sent out an email to its corporate team as a simulation of a phishing attack designed to strengthen our security against hackers," the MSG spokesman said in a statement Friday. "MSG was recently hacked and extorted using an employee login and password obtained through a similar phishing attack. Using the rings as a lure to gain employees attention was an unfortunate mistake."

The spokesman noted that the company is giving more than 275 championship rings and jewelry to players, coaches and employees, among others, valuing the total at more than $3.7 million.

Along with the phishing email, The Athletic reported that Knicks assistant coaches did not receive their championship rings during Tuesday's title ceremony ahead of the season opener and were instead handed empty boxes, in part because they had not yet been fitted for the rings. A source confirmed to ESPN that several Knicks coaches did not receive rings.

The coaches' reaction to the delayed rings ranged from annoyance to anger, according to The Athletic. A delay in some rings being handed out also occurred for the Oklahoma City Thunder after their 2025 title, The Athletic noted.

The Knicks ended a 53-year championship drought when they defeated the San Antonio Spurs in last season's NBA Finals. On Tuesday, the team had not one but two new banners in the rafters, as one was also added to honor the Knicks' win in the NBA Cup during the 2025-26 season.

articles.headline: Ex-Laker Dalton Knecht joins Knicks on two-way contract
articles.description: Former Lakers first-round pick Dalton Knecht has agreed to a two-way deal with the Knicks, his agents told ESPN's Shams Charania.
articles.body:
It didn't take long for Dalton Knecht to find a new NBA team. Just days after the Los Angeles Lakers waived their 2024 first-round pick, the New York Knicks agreed to sign the 6-foot-6 forward to a two-way deal, his agents at Excel Sports Management told ESPN's Shams Charania on Friday.

Knecht, selected with the No. 17 pick in 2024 after a standout junior season at the University of Tennessee, will look for a fresh start with the defending champs and try to tap into the promise he showed as a rookie in L.A.

During a nine-game stretch in November during the 2024-25 season, Knecht averaged 18.9 points on 55.4% shooting (52.2% from 3), 4.9 rebounds and 1.3 assists.

Knecht finished his rookie season averaging 9.1 points on 46.1% shooting (37.6% from 3) and 2.8 rebounds in 19.2 minutes across 78 games. In his second year, his playing time was cut to 10.2 minutes in 54 games, and he averaged 4.2 points on 45.5% shooting (34.2% from 3) and 1.4 rebounds.

The 25-year-old Knecht also received interest from the Cleveland Cavaliers, Sacramento Kings and Minnesota Timberwolves, sources told Charania.

New York will have to waive a two-way player to make room for Knecht. The Knicks currently have guard Jaden Akins and forwards Kevin McCullar Jr. and Tyler Nickel occupying their three allotted two-way roster spots.
